description: A central, oval-shaped form surrounded by bands of blue, black, and yellow dominates the composition. Inside the form, small brushstrokes of white and yellow dot a textured expanse of green and blue. Another black and blue form sits below the oval shape, and the two together resemble two halves of an open clamshell.
title: Abstraction
